author: Quin Henshaw
name: com.qhenshaw.terrain
description: Non-destructive tiled terrain: heights built from texture, noise and spline stamps with filters and erosion, baked to compact tiles streamed by distance, drawn as GPU-displaced CDLOD patches through BatchRendererGroup, with automatic forests and GPU-generated grass drawn the same way, baked caves, tunnels and rock arches, and streamed terrain, trunk and cave collision.
